title: Adrian Tyde shares a wonderful track "Blur"
htmlContent:
Adrian Tyde released a new single called "Blur". The single is that super incredible music, that one can’t turn away. Everything clicks and comes together to make a work of art that is enjoyable musically, and amazing artistically to make it perfect.

This track isn’t just all flow, but a lyrical masterpiece with slick writing, in the verses that are complimented by the digestible chorus that makes it a hit for the masses.
